notes: Near-identical layout to C68 with an extra numbered-feature-grid pair and confirms the screenshot-visual pattern (rc1c2c4) proposed on C68.

proposed_rules.trigger: A sibling pair [bg:color] immediately followed by [bg:image], both with no captured text, standing alone as a visual break between text sections on a solution page.
proposed_rules.decision: Model as a single 'screenshot visual' image block placed in its own section; the color shape is a decorative backdrop, not a wrapping section background for other items.
proposed_rules.rationale: Second confirmed occurrence (after C68 rc1c2c3) of this exact pair. Rejected alternatives: folding into background-container-is-section-style (image is real content) or decorative-graphics-are-noise (would drop the screenshot itself).
